discoveryChain.claim: Chinese export orders were unusually strong, prompting the associative question of where physical capacity constraints would emerge.
China exports and imports both accelerated in September.
Container shortage in Asia was already severe and expected to persist; trans-Pacific demand exceeded supply.
Multiple Chinese ports/origins had specific 40GP/40HQ equipment shortages and tight space.
Chinese container factories were running near full capacity; manufacturing capacity constrained Q4 orders, with deliveries extending into early 2021.
CIMC Q3 revenue increased about 27.5% YoY and quarterly net profit increased more than twenty-fold; first-nine-month earnings returned to growth.

candidate.name: 中集集团
reasoning: The hub did not name CIMC as the investment conclusion; CIMC is obtained by following the export surge into the physical container bottleneck.
Physical evidence showed equipment scarcity and constrained manufacturing capacity before the company earnings confirmation.
Q3 company results supplied contemporaneous operating conversion rather than relying on a later annual report.
Compared with the obvious carrier expression, CIMC is one step upstream but has direct exposure to the scarce asset being ordered.
